cues: Rigid templated structure: numbered sections for Classification, Dependencies, Key decisions, Phase 0 slice, Phases, Validation checks, Cross-cutting, AI layer, Exceptions, Deferred
Reversibility ratings (R2/R3) on each decision, with default, assumption, validated-by and revisit-trigger columns
Validation checks V0–V5 with hypothesis, method, acceptance threshold, evidence, 'unlocks (if fails)' columns; every phase has an exit check tied to a V-ID
Explicit ASSUMPTION/UNKNOWN labels on budgets, a 'Missing inputs' list, and 'N/A' entries for non-applicable sections (e.g. AI layer, migration), as if filling a checklist

Phase 0 walking-skeleton end-to-end slice with deploy, trace, alert and rehearsed rollback before features; visible UI built last; a cross-cutting matrix by phase; a Deferred list with trigger conditions
